name: Runs At Location
description: A scanner is installed at, or a scan run executed at, a place: the node where it lives (today the github_core platform node for github.com; later the workflow or job node, or the actions run for a scan run, when a collector puts one on the grid). Wildcard target because the place is whatever the producer's world has (a workflow, a host, a platform), and compliance_core must not name a producer's types. The locator property keeps the text the data gave for the place, so the location survives the day its node is not yet on the grid.

locator.description: The place as the data gave it, verbatim (unified-systems-com/tap/.github/workflows/publish-images.yml:scan).
